_note: Every way a missing `.svelte` module can be referenced, and which files the default svelte-check engine (4.7.7) checks at all. It reports TS2307 at: a string-literal import name, `typeof import()` and `import().X<T>` types, `import x = require()` (beside tsgo's own TS1202), JSDoc `@import` / `@type` / multi-line `@typedef` / `@returns` import types in a `// @ts-check` .js file, a JSDoc import type in a `// @ts-check` plain-JS component, and template expressions: `{#await import()}`, an attribute value, a snippet parameter's type, `{@const}`. Namespace members read in the template (`<Ns.Comp>`, `{Ns.value}`) add nothing: an unresolved module is `any`. Nothing is reported for an unchecked .js file, a plain-JS component with `checkJs` off, or a `// @ts-nocheck` TS component. Expected list copied from the default engine run on this tree.
